title: Ring Road
subtitle: A lap of Iceland in a van with a broken heater

cover.alt: A road disappearing into glacial hills

chapters.heading: South coast, sideways rain
chapters.body: We learned on day one that Icelandic weather doesn't change; it simply rotates through every option every ten minutes.

image.alt: Black sand beach with basalt stacks
image.caption: Reynisfjara.

chapters.heading: Jökulsárlón
chapters.body: Blue ice drifting out to sea, breaking on the black beach like scattered diamonds. We stayed until the light left.

chapters.heading: The aurora night
chapters.body: 3 a.m., the van door open, a green ribbon unspooling across the whole sky. Nobody spoke for an hour.
